mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no), 0) + 1 FROM messages WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no), 0) FROM messages WHERE group_id = #{groupId}

SELECT m.group_id, CASE WHEN m.sender_type = 'AGENT' THEN a.name ELSE u.display_name END AS sender_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.content, '$.text')) AS text, m.message_type, m.created_at FROM messages m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.author_user_id LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = m.sender_agent_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT group_id, MAX(sequence_no) AS max_seq FROM messages WHERE group_id IN #{groupId} GROUP BY group_id ) t ON t.group_id = m.group_id AND t.max_seq = m.sequence_no WHERE m.group_id IN #{groupId}

SELECT m.group_id, COUNT(*) AS unread FROM messages m LEFT JOIN group_read_state r ON r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.group_id = m.group_id WHERE m.group_id IN #{groupId} AND m.sequence_no > COALESCE(r.last_read_sequence_no, 0) AND (m.author_user_id IS NULL OR m.author_user_id <> #{userId}) GROUP BY m.group_id

SELECT m.group_id, COUNT(*) AS unread FROM messages m LEFT JOIN group_read_state r ON r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.group_id = m.group_id WHERE m.group_id IN #{groupId} AND m.sequence_no > COALESCE(r.last_read_sequence_no, 0) AND (m.author_user_id IS NULL OR m.author_user_id <> #{userId}) AND JSON_CONTAINS(m.mentions, JSON_OBJECT('type', 'USER', 'id', #{userIdText})) GROUP BY m.group_id
